# StrengthChecker (strengthchecker.com)

> StrengthChecker is a fast, scientifically grounded, ad-free strength intelligence and biometric analytics platform. It provides empirical strength standards, 1-Repetition Maximum (1RM) estimators, powerlifting coefficient scoring (DOTS, Wilks 2020, IPF GL), body composition metrics, and cardiovascular VO2 Max testing protocols.

## Core Capabilities & Tools

### Strength Standards & Percentile Rankings
- **Strength Standards Directory**: https://strengthchecker.com/strength-standards/
- **Methodology**: Evaluated via log-normal probability distribution curves modeled on competitive drug-tested powerlifting meets and athletic survey datasets.
- **Tiers**: Beginner (top 95%), Novice (top 85%), Intermediate (top 50%), Advanced (top 20%), Elite (top 5%).
- **Covered Exercises**: Bench Press, Back Squat, Deadlift, Overhead Press, Pull-Ups, Dips, Incline Bench Press, Incline Dumbbell Press, Dumbbell Bench Press, Dumbbell Curl, Dumbbell Lateral Raise, Barbell Curl, Lat Pulldown, Cable Rows, Leg Press, Leg Extension, Triceps Pushdown, Weighted Sit-Ups.

### Powerlifting & Composite Scoring
- **Strength Index Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/strength-index/ (Composite 0–100 score normalized for bodyweight, age, and gender).
- **Powerlifting Wilks & DOTS Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/wilks-calculator/ (DOTS, Wilks 2020, IPF GL points).
- **DOTS vs Wilks vs IPF GL Comparison**: https://strengthchecker.com/compare/dots-vs-wilks-vs-ipf-gl/
- **Strength Ratio & Symmetry Checker**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/strength-ratio-checker/

### 1-Repetition Maximum (1RM) Estimators
- **One Rep Max Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/one-rep-max-calculator/
- **Bench Press 1RM**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/bench-press-one-rep-max-calculator/
- **Squat 1RM**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/squat-one-rep-max-calculator/
- **Deadlift 1RM**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/deadlift-one-rep-max-calculator/
- **Pull-Ups 1RM**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/pull-ups-one-rep-max-calculator/
- **Supported Formulas**: Epley (1985), Brzycki (1993), Lander (1985), Lombardi (1989), Mayhew et al. (1992), O'Conner et al. (1989), Wathan (1994).

### Body Composition & Cardiovascular Analytics
- **Body Fat Percentage Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/body-fat-calculator/ (US Navy Tape Method).
- **Ideal Bodyweight Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/ideal-bodyweight/ (Devine, Robinson, Miller, Hamwi).
- **VO2 Max Aerobic Calculator**: https://strengthchecker.com/calculators/vo2-max-calculator/ (Cooper 12-Min, Rockport 1-Mile Walk, 1.5-Mile Run, Heart Rate Ratio).

## Mathematical Foundations & Methodology
- Detailed documentation of formulas, regression parameters, and references: https://strengthchecker.com/methodology/
- Full AI documentation manifest: https://strengthchecker.com/llms-full.txt
